title: mtx_pack~
description: `mtx_pack~` packs signal vectors from multiple inputs—usually 64 samples each—into a matrix containing all channels from all input signals. With Pd 0.54 or later it supports multichannel signals; in iemmatrix 0.4.3 and later, output is deferred to the message phase of the next cycle rather than emitted within the DSP tick (except with Pd versions earlier than 0.56).
